sources.institution: Municipalidad Provincial de Paita / CENEPRED SIGRID
sources.document: Plan de Prevencion y Reduccion del Riesgo de Desastres de la Provincia de Paita 2019-2021
admissible_claims: the plan identifies Jiron Zanjon, La Piscina, La Catarata and Villa Naval as distinct temporary drainage channels in Paita
the plan states that Jiron Zanjon drains much of Paita Baja toward a channel that discharges to the sea
the plan states that La Piscina and La Catarata drain toward Jiron Zanjon
the plan states that Villa Naval drains toward the Rada del Complejo Pesquero
the plan reports overflow and urban inundation associated with Jiron Zanjon during the 1983 El Nino episode
the plan documents district-level rainfall emergencies in 2017 without assigning every report to a specific local ravine
forbidden_inferences: the plan map or prose may be digitized as reproducible child geometry without an independently frozen spatial method
the documented drainage relation provides a reproducible outlet coordinate
a statement about insufficient section is a historical hydraulic capacity measurement
the 1983 Jiron Zanjon impact may be transferred to other named ravines
district-level 2017 emergency reports establish child-level activation for every named ravine
1997-1998 regional El Nino conditions are a child outcome without child-level evidence

sources.document: Zonificacion sismica - geotecnica de la ciudad de Paita
admissible_claims: the report distinguishes fluvial and pluvial flooding mechanisms in Paita during February-March 2017
the report attributes 2017 fluvial flooding in Paita Baja to overflow of Quebrada El Zanjon before its outlet
the report describes 2017 pluvial inundation in Paita Alta as ponding in blind basins lacking drainage
the report documents affected urban areas but does not provide a child hydrograph
forbidden_inferences: 2017 impact evidence is a measured discharge or hydrograph
the report provides an IRFEN operational threshold
pluvial blind-basin impact proves activation of a named natural ravine
hazard or zoning maps are observed event footprints unless independently frozen as such
an approximate descriptive location is a reproducible outlet

sources.document: Caracteristicas Geodinamicas en el Distrito de Paita (Provincia de Paita - Region Piura)
admissible_claims: the report identifies Quebrada El Zanjon as the principal local ravine and names Nueva Esperanza, La Piscina, Catarata and Villa Naval in the local drainage setting
the report describes rainfall-triggered geodynamic flow processes in Paita
the report describes overflow of El Zanjon as a mechanism that can affect population and public works
forbidden_inferences: the report figure may be digitized into reproducible catchment polygons without an independently frozen georeferencing and delineation method
all named channels share one activation state
geodynamic susceptibility is a dated observed activation
the report supplies historical hydraulic capacity or an IRFEN decision threshold

the report discusses the 2017 coastal El Nino rainfall context

the pumping-station study area is the Quebrada El Zanjon catchment polygon
